response.why: Fixed scoring format: one score per leaf. Critical to finally land a permanent — turn 9, still 0 lands, life 11, opponent has a growing board. Darkslick Shores is the most flexible (both colors) and its worst-case leaf still beats every pass leaf, so it should win as the chosen action.
response.plan: Now that scoring is fixed, land drops should register every turn. Get to 3-4 lands ASAP to deploy Preacher of the Schism as a deathtouch blocker, then Sheoldred. Hold Floodpits Drowner for flash tempo/removal of an attacker.
